$comment: Ratchet baseline for tools/check-layers.js. Only ever lower these.
$note: P4's one sanctioned increase (no-circular 769 -> 773, for the
PaintToolModeBase hoist into stroke_base.ts) is repaid: P5 deleted the nine
pbvh*.ts files and the tools.ts side-effect import that closed those cycles,
landing at 713 -- below both the P4 budget and the pre-P4 769. There is no
outstanding exception. See P9 step 1 (layer-ratchet plan).
713 rather than 712 because the two generic brush-radius ToolOps hoisted
out of pbvh_base.ts into stroke_base.ts need core/context's ToolContext /
ViewContext types, which is one new direct edge on an already-cyclic node.
P6 (W1a) moved SelMask out of editors/view3d/selectmode.ts into
core/select_types.ts, so the ~30 modules that only wanted the mask no longer
pull in a view3d editor module: no-circular 713 -> 673, core-no-addons
P7 (W1b) made core/data_kinds.ts a leaf -- it now imports only
core/geometry_contract.ts, with a generic Ctx in place of ToolContext and
GeometryDataRef in place of SceneObjectData -- so the registry no longer
reaches an addon through core/context: core-no-addons-transitive
1564 -> 1472. The four registries AddonAPI gained in the same step
(file_formats, props_panels, uv_sources, file_migrations) follow the same
rule and cost nothing.
P8 (W1c) cut entry_point.js's five `import * as mesh...` re-exports and its
three mesh side-effect imports (they moved into the addon's own main.ts),
moved the properties editor's CustomData/BVH/procedural panels behind the
props-panel registry, and split View3D's keymap and core's legacy
struct-name table into per-addon contributions. The host's module graph no
longer reaches the mesh subsystem through its entry point:
core-no-addons 24 -> 19, core-no-addons-typeonly 14 -> 12,
core-no-addons-transitive 1472 -> 1152, no-circular 673 -> 631.
P9 (W1d) severed the last host->addon edges that were not BREP code: three
dead side-effect imports (MainMenu.js -> mesh_createops, view3d.ts ->
mesheditor), MaterialEditor's `import {Mesh}` (material slots read through
SceneObjectData.usesMaterial), ToolMode.drawObject's geometry parameter
retyped Mesh -> SceneObjectData across view3d_toolmode/selecttool/view3d,
a new BVH.redrawAll() so sculptcore.ts no longer reaches for BVHFlags,
editor_base's three getValue<Mesh> -> getValue<SceneObjectData>, and
structural local interfaces in view3d_utils/widget_tools in place of
`import type {Mesh}`. transform_ops.ts now reads SelMask.FACE instead of
MeshTypes.FACE. Result: core-no-mesh 2 -> 0, core-no-addons 19 -> 0 (13
moved to the new brep-consumers-no-addons rule), core-no-addons-typeonly
12 -> 7, core-no-addons-transitive 1152 -> 800, no-circular 631 -> 586.
Six rules are now `severity: error` and read 0. Three remain `warn`, each
with a dated owner in .dependency-cruiser.cjs:
brep-consumers-no-addons (13) -- scripts/tet, scripts/hair and the BREP
transform stack; closes with P13.
core-no-addons-typeonly (7) -- Class A type-only leaks; closes with P13.
core-no-addons-transitive (800) -- every surviving route runs through a
BREP_CONSUMERS intermediate, and dependency-cruiser 17.4.0's
IReachabilityToRestrictionType admits only path/pathNot/reachable, so
the exclusion cannot be expressed. Flips to error for free at P13.
no-circular (586) -- closes with P17.
